text: Every screen labels what's real and what's simulated.

This is one candidate source: fifty-one detections on twenty-eight different days, from five instruments. That's Carbon Mapper's own plume image, drawn where they put it. We keep what's known, a plume at this point and rate, apart from what's inferred, that these detections share a source, and from what space can't tell us: the operator, or the faulty component.
